title: Get Shop LIVE Performance Overview
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /analytics/202609/shop_lives/overview_performance

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns overall performance metrics for all LIVE stream sessions under a certain shop.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
start_date_ge string Y 2024-09-01 Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)
end_date_lt string Y 2024-09-08 End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)
today bool N true If "today" is set to true, start_date_ge and end_date_lt will be overwritten.
The response will contain real-time metrics of today (local time)
granularity string N 1D Granularity of the data.
Available values:
  • ALL: Aggregate data for the full requested time range.
  • 1D: Daily data. Default value: ALL | currency |string |N |USD |Currently, only local currency is supported in the response.

Available values:

  • USD: US dollars.
  • LOCAL: Local currency where the shop is located. Default value: LOCAL | account_type |string |N |ALL |Types of the accounts under which videos were created. Available values:
  • ALL: All account types.
  • LINKED_ACCOUNTS: Linked accounts.
  • AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS: Affiliate accounts. Default value: ALL |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202609/shop_lives/overview_performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&start_date_ge=2024-09-01&end_date_lt=2024-09-08&today=true&granularity=1D&currency=USD&account_type=ALL

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^latest_available_date string 2024-09-07 Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).
^performance object Overall performance data for livestream.
^^intervals []object Interval data for the requested time range. The time range of each interval is determined by the granularity.
^^^avg_live_auction_price object Average price per item sold for LIVE auction products.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^avg_viewing_duration int 0 Average viewing duration in seconds.
^^^ctor_sku_order string 0.0000 Ratio of LIVE-attributed SKU orders to product clicks in raw decimal format.
^^^end_date string 2026-09-02 End date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, exclusive.
^^^live_attributed_gmv object GMV attributed to LIVE streams.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^live_attributed_items_sold int 0 Number of items sold attributed to LIVE streams.
^^^live_attributed_sku_orders int 0 Number of paid SKU orders attributed to LIVE streams.
^^^live_auction_attributed_gmv object GMV attributed to LIVE auction products.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^live_auction_attributed_items_sold int 0 Number of items sold attributed to LIVE auction products.
^^^live_auction_attributed_sku_orders int 0 Number of paid SKU orders attributed to LIVE auction products.
^^^live_ctr string 0.0000 Ratio of product clicks to product impressions from LIVE streams in raw decimal format.
^^^live_gmv object Direct GMV generated from LIVE streams.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^live_indirect_gmv object Indirect GMV generated from LIVE streams.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^show_gpm object LIVE-attributed GMV generated per 1,000 impressions.
^^^^amount string 0.00 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^^start_date string 2026-08-27 Start date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive.
^^^views int 0 Number of LIVE views.
^updated_at string 2026-09-02 21:25:00 Time when the data was last updated in shop registered timezone.
